chapter.verse: Topa phat un! Vantung panin Topa phat un la, a sangna panin amah phat un!
Ama vantungmi khempeuh aw, amah phat un, ama mihonpite khempeuh aw, amah phat un!
Ni leh kha aw, amah phat un, a taang aksi khempeuh aw, amah phat un!
Van sangpente leh vante tunga om tuite aw, amah phat un!
Topa ’ min amaute phatsak un! Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in thu pia a, amaute a piang hi.
Amaute a tawntung a om dingin amah in kipsak hi; a palsat loh ding uh thupiakna amah in a bawl hi.
Leitung panin, Topa phat un, no gunpi liante leh tuipi thuk khempeuh,
mei leh gial, tuikhal leh vuuk, ama thupiakna a mang huihpi!
Mualliante leh mualneute khempeuh, gah a nei singkungte leh taamtaak singkung khempeuh!
Gamsate leh innsate khempeuh, a bokvak ganhingte leh a leeng vasate!
Leitung kumpite leh mihing khempeuhte, leitung uliante leh thukhente khempeuh!
Nungak leh tangvalte, teeksiate leh naupangte!
Topa ’ min phatsak un, bang hang hiam cih leh ama min bek lian a, ama minthan’na in leitung leh vantung sangin sangzaw lai hi.
Amah in ama mite thahat sak a, ama misiangthote khempeuh, ama mai-a om Israelte khempeuh in amah phat uh hi. Topa phat un!
